subject: [PATCH v8 28/30] mm: handle PMD swap entry faults on swap-in

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem where PMD (Page Map Directory) swap entries would fault indefinitely when trying to swap in a huge page. The patch introduces a new function, do_huge_pmd_swap_page(), which resolves the whole mapping at PMD granularity and handles various failure cases, such as cache splitting or allocation failures. It also ensures that the folio is properly dropped from the swap cache if it has never been mapped or is not up-to-date. The patch aims to prevent a transient PMD-order allocation failure from becoming a VM_FAULT_OOM error.
